statusLine.command: bash -c 'RUNTIME=$(command -v bun 2>/dev/null || command -v node 2>/dev/null); plugin_dir=$(ls -d "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/claude-hud/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | awk -F/ '"'"'{ print $(NF-1) "\t" $0 }'"'"' | sort -t. -k1,1n -k2,2n -k3,3n -k4,4n | tail -1 | cut -f2-); RNAME=${RUNTIME##*/}; if [ "$RNAME" = "bun" ]; then exec "$RUNTIME" --env-file /dev/null "${plugin_dir}src/index.ts"; else exec "$RUNTIME" "${plugin_dir}dist/index.js"; fi'
